quest.title: Gift and Intent
quest.description: Noelle has, as is her wont, extended a helping hand to Bea, who is facing a bit of a romantic quandary. After some discussion, you decide to use a gift to help Bea get her feelings across...

dialogues.speaker: Beatrice
dialogues.text: *sigh* How am I ever going to get Quinn to listen to me...?

talks.objective: Give the Handpicked Gift to Bea
Take a picture of the view of Falcon Coast from Cape Oath

dialogues.speaker: Beatrice
dialogues.text: Oh? You're back! Find any romantic locations?

dialogues.speaker: Beatrice
dialogues.text: Oh... then please keep looking! This is really important to me.

talks.objective: Take a picture of the top of Starsnatch Cliff at night (19:00 – 24:00)
Take a picture at Windrise that captures the river and shade of the trees

dialogues.speaker: Beatrice
dialogues.text: ...Quinn! Look! That's Falcon Coast — right there!

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Wow, you really can see it... I've always thought it was far away... I had no idea how close it was.

dialogues.speaker: Beatrice
dialogues.text: Perhaps... there are other things around you that seem far away, but are actually very close...

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: You're right... So many potential customers out there...
